title: AssetLiabilityRules
principle: Asset/liability classification is a value-and-obligation classification layer and does not by itself establish legal title, accounting treatment, or jurisdictional status.

engineClassification.asset: Positive governed economic contribution, resource, right, receivable, or beneficial control recognized under the applicable model.
engineClassification.liability: Obligation, burden, required outflow, negative economic exposure, or unresolved cost recognized under the applicable model.
engineClassification.contingent: Material economic exposure exists but recognition depends on a future condition, eligibility or evidence gate.
engineClassification.unclassified: Evidence or authority is insufficient for classification.

pulseValueRule.description: Where the configured Pulse–Value assessment compares Pulse burden against value sent/realized, a positive net contribution may be represented as an Asset and a negative net contribution as a Liability for the engine.

rules: Tokenization does not create an Asset.
Minting does not create an Asset.
A liability classification does not automatically establish legal debt without the applicable evidence and jurisdictional basis.
Full-cost accounting is preferred for economic measurement.
Asset and liability state must remain traceable to evidence and source records.
